name: UK energy price cap
summary: Cap £1,723; Cornwall Insight forecasts close to £2,000 from January, a rise below the 20% Alert line
state: The Ofgem cap for October–December is £1,723 a year for a typical dual-fuel household. Cornwall Insight's latest forecast puts the January cap close to £2,000, about 16% higher (Cornwall Insight; Restless). That is above the 5% Watch line but below the 20% Alert line and the £2,200 cap line. Ofgem announces the January cap by 25 Nov.
for_you: Households on default tariffs would pay more from January if the forecast holds; Ofgem publishes the cap by 25 Nov.

sources.title: Cornwall Insight — Predictions and insights into the default tariff cap
Restless — Energy bills forecast to hit nearly £2,000 a year from January 2027

why: The Ofgem cap sets bills for most UK households — a direct cost-of-living signal.
drivers: Wholesale gas and power prices, network costs, policy levies.

rubric.normal: Typical dual-fuel cap < £1,700/yr and next forecast change < +5%.
